hash_convention: SHA-256 of raw file bytes exactly as stored
source_tree_revision_note: The exact revision for any run is recorded by that run. The recommendation corpus and guideline scope are guarded by their own receipts (recommendation_corpus.receipt.json, guideline_scope_v1/receipt.json) plus builder self-hash; spec v3 records their current hashes in its artifact_freeze_ledger.
two_tier_rationale: v1 pinned the append-only results ledger and the working notes as design-binding, so ordinary appends invalidated it. Splitting the tiers keeps the freeze meaningful: design_binding_files must not change without a version bump; observed_files are recorded for provenance and expected to drift.
design_binding_rule: These carry the freeze. If any one changes, this receipt becomes historical: issue v4 and state the reason. Never edit a version in place after viewing current-paper results.
observed_rule: Recorded for provenance at receipt creation. Drift is expected. The implementation cards become design-binding at the pre-H2H lock and must be re-pinned into design_binding_files at that point.

historical_versions.note: Pinned by five frozen artifacts (evidence bundle receipt, DermLIP perception receipt, three development-manifest files). Must never be edited.
